actions: CALL 'GLC020' USING WS-ﾎｳｺｳ WS-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ LK-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ

rules.sentence: When `LK-ｻﾞﾝﾀﾞｶ` is more than 0 and `LK-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ` is not spaces; and `WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ` is 0, it sets `LK-ﾘｿｸ` to 0, calls `GLC020`, performs `ﾋﾜﾘ-RTN`, and returns to its caller.
When `LK-ｻﾞﾝﾀﾞｶ` is more than 0 and `LK-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ` is not spaces; and `WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ` is not 0, it sets `LK-ﾘｿｸ` to 0, calls `GLC020`, and returns to its caller.
When `LK-ｻﾞﾝﾀﾞｶ` is at most 0 or `LK-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ` is spaces, it sets `LK-ﾘｿｸ` to 0 and returns to its caller.

actions: COMPUTE WS-ﾆｯｽｳ = FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(LK-ｷｼﾞｭﾝﾋﾞ) - FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ)

rules.sentence: When `WS-ﾆｯｽｳ` is more than 0, it computes `WS-ﾆｯｽｳ` as `FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(LK-ｷｼﾞｭﾝﾋﾞ) - FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ)` and computes `LK-ﾘｿｸ` as `LK-ｻﾞﾝﾀﾞｶ * WS-ﾈﾝﾘ * WS-ﾆｯｽｳ / 365`.
When `WS-ﾆｯｽｳ` is at most 0, it computes `WS-ﾆｯｽｳ` as `FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(LK-ｷｼﾞｭﾝﾋﾞ) - FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-ｷｻﾝﾋﾞ)`.
